title: I just built a team of Bots that manages my family's health #shorts
description:
I just built a team of Bots that completely manages my family’s health.

And each of these Bots is a specialist in our wellness stack.

Tracker Bot is in charge of continuous health monitoring.

Any family member can live connect their Whoop, Apple Watch or Oura Ring, and Tracker will proactively monitor their health data and give live alerts if anything looks out of whack.

Dash Bot then takes that data and visualizes it in a centralized hub that the family can see.

Now based on their health data, we have other Bots designed for nutrition, fitness, mindfulness and sleep that will take proactive actions on their behalf.

Anytime you message Fit Bot, it’ll build and adjust your daily training plan based on your recovery score.

Calm Bot will automatically nudge you with a notification if your heart rate spikes too high.

And all of this is happening proactively based on the live health data tracking, but also reactively whenever anyone messages through.

When anyone in the family needs to book a doctor, they can just text Doc Bot, which will automatically schedule it for them.

You can see how far this goes.

Now the cool part is…I built this whole suite of Bots using Grok Bot.

And if you haven’t tried this yet, this is now the easiest way to build with AI.

Think of Grok Bot as the platform that can spin up individual Bots.

Each Bot works on a shared cloud computer, can collaborate with each other, and the UI feels a lot more like texting a friend than needing to build software.

You can see all of those names on the sidebar are the health Bots we have working together as a team to run the full workflow.

But this is only one small example of using Bots to do work.

The next two bots we’re building are Chief, a Chief of Staff Bot, and Zero, a Bot specifically designed to clear my inbox.

Zero will also spin up new Bots automatically to solve incoming work requests that come in via email.

So it’s Bots making Bots all the way down.

You can see once you get started building out Bots it is extremely addicting and simple to use.

The Grok Bot platform was built by the SpaceXAI team.

And I think this chat based UI is sneakily the most compelling method I’ve used for multithreaded work.

If you wanna try this out, comment “Grok” and I’ll send through the links for how to set it up @Grok
